description: Check a spec without rendering: parse errors, unknown icons (with the closest ids), bad references and layout warnings, each with a code, a message and concrete fixes. Returns JSON with ok, the counts, the diagnostics and the diagram's size.

name.description: File name stem for outputs: lowercase letters, digits and -. Default: the spec file's name, else diagram.

spec.description: The diagram spec as YAML (or JSON) text. Pass this or spec_path, not both.

spec_path.description: Absolute path of a spec file on this machine (stdio only). Its folder resolves relative icons: paths.

name: validate
title: Validate a spec
